memoryBuilder.verseText: Jesus has power on earth to forgive sins.

sequence.prompt: What happened in the crowded house? Put it in order.

items.label: The house was packed full of people
Four friends carried a man on a mat
They dug through the roof and lowered him in
Jesus forgave him, and he got up and walked

matches.prompt: Match each part of the story to what it means.
matches.questionTemplate: What does the story say about {left}?

pairs.right: Four friends made a way to Jesus
Jesus forgave them first of all
Jesus mended them to prove He can forgive

application.question: Jesus can forgive sins. What will you bring to Him today?
application.followUp: The four friends thought legs were the biggest problem in that room. Jesus knew the biggest problem was inside, and He is the only one who can reach it. Bring Him anything at all, because Jesus can forgive sins.
